name: Byakuya Monogatari ~Winchester-ke no Matsuei~
original_name: 白夜物語 ～ウィンチェスター家の末裔～
source:
College student Hiroyuki Sato came to a hot spring resort and was shocked by western type mansion known as witch's house and decided to sneak in.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大学生佐藤博之来到一处温泉乡，被当地一栋人称“魔女之家”的西式洋馆深深吸引，决定偷偷潜入其中。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
